# MakeHuman CC0 source assets

These editable source meshes are extracted from checked MakeHuman Community
asset packs. They are kept outside Godot import with `vendor/.gdignore`; the
project runtime uses generated GLB and texture files instead.

Sources:

- `Suits 02` (CC0): Viking tunic, Viking pants, Viking boots, Galactic Warrior
  Uniform, MC SkinSuit 2022 underlayer, and Monk Robe.
  https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/suits02.html
- `Shoes 01` (CC0): Male Boots and Male Ankle Boots.
  https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shoes01.html
- `Glasses 01` (CC0): Library Glasses Male and Round Glasses Leopard.
  https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/glasses01.html

The imported objects preserve their original UVs and MakeHuman fitting rules.
Their Blender objects also carry `source_license` and `source_folder`
properties.
